content: On what date did the portfolio reach its highest value?

The portfolio hit its highest value of **$50,694.08 on December 11, 2024**, more than halfway through the second year of this buy-and-hold run for META. It started from $10,000 on January 3, 2023.

Keep in mind, this is a historical simulation, not a prediction or trading recommendation — past results don't guarantee future outcomes.
